note: On profile he is the stated ICP: a 49-year-old commercial real estate broker running a $2.8m transaction, lifelong athlete, roughly 160 lb after an 80 lb loss, active with sauna and cold plunges, explicitly chasing good-to-great — 'I'd really like to see my best body.' Health is the neglected area, not a crisis. He fails on income alone, and fails it hard: seven months without a commission, about $1,000 in the account, car and insurance unpaid, no savings, credit score down from low 700s to mid 500s, and a $5,000 legal retainer competing for the same money. This is the third corpus case where 'makes good money' is the only criterion that breaks, and here it broke on timing rather than earning power — the commission is real and large, it is just seven weeks away.
